items.item: Expediting bonus speeds up the late delivery
items.needed: The 'pay an expediting bonus' answer to the late-delivery message must move the part that is late, and say which part, so Comms and Procurement are not misled.
items.sawRunning: Weather, two contracts: Taiga KL-2000 (late, 6 Dec, needed 19 Nov) and Flask PT-1.6 (6 Aug). The option read 'PROCUREMENT Taiga KL-2000 arrives 5 Nov 2030 instead of 6 Dec 2030 (needed 19 Nov 2030)'. After paying, Procurement's Contracts timeline showed Taiga arriving 5 Nov (13.4 d early) and Flask unchanged at 6 Aug; the news line named the part and both dates.
added: consequence chip naming the part, old and new date and need date
items.reason: The players' exact problem cannot recur: the right part moves and the screen says so beforehand. The 'no answer' line truthfully shows that ignoring slips a different, unrelated delivery (Flask from Helix), which reads oddly against the text 'Feldwerk's queue sets the pace', but it is stated, not hidden.

removed: finished one-off projects from the picker
items.reason: Fixes the bug directly with no new UI. Side effect: Mars 'Capitol lobbying push' (kind lobbying) is now one-off too; harmless.

items.item: 'Affects planner' options rewritten into effects that happen, launch promise with follow-up
items.needed: No option should promise a change at another station that never happens; a cross-station option should be something the team can actually see and decide.
items.sawRunning: Weather: 'Promise launch on the announced date' showed 'Binds the launch to 30 Jun 2030: if the Planner launches later, a follow-up costs Government −5 to −20'. I promised, moved the launch to 5 Nov at the Planner, and within seconds 'You promised me a date' (Lindqvist) arrived with two options (8 M + Government −5 + Partners +5, or Government −15 / Public +5) and 'no answer: Government −20'; the generic 'You moved the launch' did not also fire. 'Have Science re-check the radiation margins' showed 'SCIENCE research and part tests 15 % slower until 12 Jul 2030 (nothing running now)'. The Planner's launch popover says nothing about the promise.
added: two follow-up messages (weather Lindqvist, Mars Duarte)
removed: 'planner finds the mass / adjusts the antenna plan / keeps the date / gains a test facility' promises and their dead constraint/service effects
items.reason: Every rewritten option now states something that really happens. The Planner still sees no sign of the promise, but the cost is borne by Comms and the outcome text tells Comms to tell the Planner, so nothing is misleading. Minor: the new 'Rent Meridian's storm imagery until the launch' option repeats an option of Lindqvist's 'First storm, no new satellite' message almost word for word.

items.item: Messages that change a teammate's work stay open 45 days, real time shown
items.needed: Time to ask a teammate and answer before the message expires, and a deadline in real time, plus knowing what not answering costs.
items.sawRunning: Budget review arrived 12 Mar with 'by 26 Apr' (45 d, was 25) and 'NO ANSWER BY 26 APR 2030: Shared budget −25 M, Government −5' under the options. Deadlines show '· 0:36 real time'. Messages with no teammate effect keep short deadlines (storm message 20 d expired in ~10 s at 2x while I clicked).
added: 'No answer by <date>' line with its chips
real-time remainder next to the deadline
items.reason: The 25 M loss in the evidence came from a 49 s deadline and an invisible cost of ignoring; both are gone. More messages are open at once (I saw three), but none forces a decision less. The promise message itself (a planner matter) is not extended because its effect is a flag; minor.

items.item: Exact consequences on options and projects instead of ↑/↓ hints and AFFECTS tags
items.needed: Hints that match what happens; players liked the hint chips for showing who reacts and which teammate to ask.
items.sawRunning: Each option has one row of chips in the same place and size as the old hints: 'Government +10', 'Costs 8 M of the shared budget', 'PROCUREMENT new orders +10 % price until 6 Jul 2030'. I took the home-suppliers pledge and Procurement's Taiga price went from 29.1 M (+15 % already active) to 31.6 M, i.e. +10 % as stated. Chips update live: the rush-fee option read 'no delivery under contract yet: nothing moves' before any order and 'all 2 deliveries 1 mo earlier' after two. Project picker rows 'Now / When done' are readable; the longest chip (partner engine offer) wraps to four lines.
added: consequence chips with numbers and dates
removed: 'Hints show who is likely to react…' note
items.reason: Same visual weight as before; trust arrows and '+5/+10' carry nearly the same information, so the number costs nothing in legibility, and the cross-station lines are exactly where the old hints lied. A truthful-but-vaguer middle form would not have been clearly better: the misleading cases were all cross-station, where a date and a part name are what the teammate needs to answer. The station README (line 44) still records the old direction and should be updated by its owner.

items.item: In-flight panel 'In flight · decided at launch' with score
items.needed: A Comms player wanted to see how relationships bear on mission success, and not find out only after launch.
items.sawRunning: Right column under the two project slots: four weather rows (five Mars) with ✓/✗, the condition with today's value ('Government above 60 (now 40)'), a ±2–3 % figure, a net line ('Net now −3 %: each achieved goal has a 3 % risk of being lost in flight') and 'score 23/50' (meaning only in a tooltip). When Meridian's ground station finished, 'First image downlink' flipped from ✗ −2 % to ✓ +3 % and the net to +2 %. Screen stayed calm at 1280x720; the panel fills space that held the slot-3 line and emptiness.
items.reason: Gives Comms concrete targets that touch the goals and makes the launch card no surprise. 'score 23/50' is a new term a first-timer may ask about; not severe.

items.needed: Know what trust does without finding a hover tooltip.
items.sawRunning: One small line under each bar: 'Above 70: more funding offers', 'Above 70: orders −10 % price and time', 'Above 70: event budget cuts halved', 'Above 70: more partner deals'; at Government 20 it changed to a red 'Audits and budget cuts likelier' line.
items.reason: Short, always visible, answers the player's question.

items.needed: Notice a new message before it expires.
